title: fix(color-loupe): add adaptive white-first border for WCAG 1.4.11 (#6513)
evidence:
**fix(color-loupe):** Added an adaptive white-first inner border to `<swc-color-loupe>` so its chrome meets WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast (≥3:1) across the color spectrum.

The inner border's opacity now escalates above its default floor only when the white outer halo can't itself carry 3:1 contrast
